name: The Gleaming Marquis
description: A being of reflected light and polished, impossible geometry, his form a mosaic of stolen moments of vanity and pride. He is blindingly beautiful and utterly cold.
background: Forged from the collective narcissism and self-absorption of dreaming minds, he was recruited by the Court for his innate understanding of mortal vanity and his skill at corruption from within.
goals: To subvert the Anchorhold rituals by tempting and corrupting its guardians, turning their own virtues and desires against them, making the invasion an inside job.
